title: USVBench certificate schema v3 (minor 1: condition stamps; minor 2: release code tree, physics/vessel stamps, outcome); journal ids: schema-3 condition stamps, D7 envelopes, D11 pairing (F7); G9: controller.configuration.mppi_implementation (MPPI)

anyOf.description: journal docking (F5 D2 item 14): no level table is read; the env stamps the journal plan

dynamic_hazards_header.description: D7 header (journal_env_mixin dynamic_hazard_header plus family fields); G23c: runtime_rule (release.rule_block_for plus motion_rule) and exposure_summary (d7_exposure.exposure_summary, written by cert_v3.build over the counted records, recomputed by validate_cert_v3.dynamic_exposure_errors)

not_applicable_doses.description: G23e: tiers not applicable by design (station keeping BlueBoat: [1]); their per-dose rows are all zero; distinct from not_admitted

appearing_hazards_header.description: G3 appearing-obstacle suite header (journal_env_mixin appearing_hazard_header); present only with the appearing suite

wind_coefficients.description: G16: pinned vs used wind-load coefficients of the journal vessel and the diagnostic centroid-offset yaw term (usvbench.wind_coefficients/2); windcoef.* overrides are diagnostic only

rollpitch_damping.description: T25 (owner decision T1.35b): journal-default vs used roll/pitch linear damping of the hydro_v2 hull model (usvbench.rollpitch_damping/1); hydro.rollpitch_zeta overrides are diagnostic only

runtime_paths.description: D19 runtime pool-path cfg fields (journal_d7_pool_path, journal_d7_pool_dir, d7_pool_dir, d7_pool_file) set with --set; runtime, never science; the pinned pool is identified by dynamic_hazards_header.pool_digest / pool_manifest_sha256

appearing_hazards.description: G3 appearing-obstacle stamp envelope {payload, sha256} (conditions/appearing/stamp.py; G20d schema usvbench.appearing_stamp/3)

green_water_report.description: T25 (owner decision T1.35d) report-only green-water point sets of the episode (conditions/green_water.py report_episode; WAM-V deck edge): {set: {record (rule/1 record form), diagnostics (G18 form)}}; checked by green_water_rule.report_errors_all; never part of any verdict

green_water_diagnostics.description: G18 read-only green-water diagnostics of the episode (conditions/green_water.py GreenWaterMonitor.episode_diagnostics; usvbench.green_water.diagnostics/1): the N-substep detector after the settling window, events and exposure after it, per-point up-crossings of the calm freeboard and of the calm mean level; checked by green_water_rule.diagnostics_errors; never part of the verdict

journal_contract.description: F5/F6 contract metrics of the finished episode: journal_contract_record(i) and/or journal_episode_results[i], latched by the env before the reset

condition_stamp_v3.description: E3 hydro_v2 condition stamp (tasks/_shared/conditions/stamp.py stamp_conditions_v3); digest = SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of parameters, as for schema 2

dynamic_hazard_stamp.description: E4/D7 per-episode dynamic-hazard stamp envelope (conditions/dynamic/stamp.py make_stamp); sha256 over the canonical JSON of payload

appearing_hazard_stamp.description: G3/G20b appearing-obstacle stamp envelope (conditions/appearing/stamp.py make_appearing_stamp); sha256 over the canonical JSON of payload; scripts/appearing_exposure.py re-derives the digest and recomputes the trigger record's closing_speed_mps (surge x cos bearing) and realized_ttc_s (max(gap, 0) / closing speed, null when not closing)

mppi_implementation.description: G9: the MPPI control-step implementation actually used by eval_mppi (mppi_controller.CudaGraphMPPI 'cuda_graph_v1' or the eager rollout), the number of CUDA graphs captured and how many of those captures replaced a live graph (recaptures)

avoidance_layer.description: G17 / G24b: the obstacle-avoidance layer of the journal classical controllers los_pid_avoid_v2 / los_pid_cont_avoid_v2 / docking_runup_pid_avoid_v2 (scripts/journal_avoidance.py): frozen constants (scripts/classical_avoidance_v2.json), provenance and the run telemetry written at the end of the run

planner_memory.description: G25 / G25b / G24b: the ray-return memory (no expiry since G24b) and circumscribed-radius ladder of the journal planner planner_los_pid_mem_v2 (scripts/planner_memory.py, classical_planner_pid.journal_memory_ladder): rule constants, derived constants, ladder rule and values, provenance and the run telemetry written at the end of the run; validate_cert_v3.planner_memory_errors pins every value to planner_memory and the vessel registry

green_water_header.description: G10 green-water exclusion rule A + B (conditions/green_water_rule.py): static rule, formula stamp (D9 wave-following per-cycle wetness, NORDFORSK 0.05), detection definition and the cell summary over the counted episodes; required for journal certificates whose condition stack includes waves

diagnostics.description: G18 non-binding diagnostics over the counted episodes (green_water_rule.diagnostics_summary): settled share, event rate, simulated per-cycle exceedance per point and candidate verdicts for the owner; present only when every counted record carries green_water_diagnostics; recomputed by the validator

spawn.description: G18 option conditions/wave_spawn.py (cfg.journal_spawn_on_waves): present only when the reset rows are placed on the filtered wave surface

report_points.description: T25 (owner decision T1.35d) static block of the report-only point sets (conditions/green_water.py report_header; G28: WAM-V pontoon top line, set wamv_pontoon_top; v2.5 certificates: WAM-V deck edge, set wamv_deck_edge): version usvbench.green_water.report_points/1, binding false, the points with their calm freeboard and source; never part of any verdict

report.description: T25 (owner decision T1.35d) non-binding summary of the report-only point sets over the counted episodes (green_water_rule.report_summary): per set the per-episode share, the settled share and event rate and the simulated per-cycle exceedance per point; recomputed by the validator

exclusion.description: T25 (owner decision T1.35c) the BINDING exclusion verdict, green-water rule/2 (green_water_rule.exclusion_block): formula probability > 0.05 or simulated per-cycle exceedance at the worst point after the settling window > 0.05; rule/1 (header.green_water.cell) is reported, not binding; recomputed by the validator

probe.description: G28 (owner decision 2026-10-03 17:0x item 3) the exclusion probe: set blueboat_deck_edge or wamv_deck_edge and its labels (= header.green_water.detection.points labels); WAM-V pontoon top is report-only (header.green_water.report_points set wamv_pontoon_top); absent on v2.5 certificates (WAM-V pontoon top binding there); recomputed by the validator

green_water_record.description: G10 per-episode simulated green-water record (conditions/green_water.py GreenWaterMonitor.episode_record): a declared deck-edge point below the instantaneous water surface for >= N consecutive physics substeps
